 Sofía Vergara and Imagine Dragons frontman Dan Reynolds were seen getting quite cozy during a romantic dinner together in L.A. ... and we have the pics and video.
 In the exclusive photos obtained by TMZ ... Sofía and Dan can be seen holding hands throughout their late-night meal last night at Beverly Hills' Cipriani.
 Play video content 
 IMAGINE ROMANCE 
 Video: Sofía Vergara and Dan Reynolds Hold Hands During Cozy Night Out 
 BACKGRID 
 While their chemistry may be undeniable ... the two also enjoyed their outing with a pair of friends, including Anastasia Soare .
 Backgrid 
 We're told Sofía and Dan made a secret exit at one point ... high-tailing it out the back door of the restaurant around 12:30 AM.
 Their night out comes after Sofía's ex-husband Joe Manganiello made some bombshell claims about their relationship in his new memoir "Bloodlines."
